content.short: Business banking for startups and AI agents, with cards, global payments, crypto and yield.
content.description: Meow gives companies checking accounts through partner banks, Visa cards that earn 2.5% back on AI spending, global payments and crypto, including sending and receiving stablecoins. Idle cash can go into a commercial paper account run by its SEC-registered adviser. It also lets founders open an account through an AI agent such as Claude or ChatGPT, which handles the onboarding by command line and chat.
content.meta: Meow offers startup banking with stablecoin payments, AI-spend cashback cards and yield, and onboarding through AI agents.
